messages:
eng-deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy -> prod us-east-1 for service inference-runtime.
eng-deploy-bot: Tag: v2.3.0-spark | Commit: 8f9b2c4 | initial traffic: 2% -> hold 5m for smoke. Change window: 22:00-23:00 UTC, rollback window until 22:10. CI: https://ci.redwood/commit/8f9b2c4
maya nguyen: got it, i'll run the smoke prompt set and watch latency/error dashboards.
frank li: quick Q — did we pin the model variant for this canary? we had a config flip last week.
eng-deploy-bot: yes. deploying with explicit variant in rollout config:
```
model_variant: "gptq-4x-quant8"
batch_size: 8
traffic_percent: 2
canary_hold_secs: 300
rollback_on_error_rate_pct: 0.5
```
jess rath: thanks. i'll keep an eye on quality evals (prompt-runner) and rerank signals.
runtime-sre-bot: Smoke metrics snapshot at +90s: p95 latency 120ms (baseline 115ms, +4%), error rate 0.21% (baseline 0.09%). No infra OOMs. Flagging for human review.
maya nguyen: noted — latency small bump but within our canary threshold (p95 +10% allowed). error rate slightly higher, jess can you check eval diffs?
jess rath: pulling eval diffs now. small increase in token-level repetition on one prompt set, not widespread. looks like a sampling artifact. :thinking_face:
oliver k: seeing a short 502 spike on target-node-7 around t+2m, investigating logs.
frank li: i'm going to restart mixer on the canary nodes, could be a transient proxy limit.
eng-deploy-bot: Action: restart mixer pods on canary nodes -> started.
eng-deploy-bot: Action: restart complete.
runtime-sre-bot: Post-restart metrics at +4m: p95 116ms, error rate 0.11% — back near baseline.
jess rath: from an eval perspective: ok to ramp to 10% after another 2m if metrics remain stable. i sign off for 10% (jess rath). :white_check_mark:
maya nguyen: +1, continuing to monitor quality decks.
eng-deploy-bot: Ramping canary to 10% traffic now.
eng-deploy-bot: Canary reached 10% in prod/us-east-1. Holding 5m for miniwave checks.
runtime-sre-bot: miniwave report: no scaling events, no increased tail latency, error budget consumption nominal.
frank li: confirm pinning strategy? once we promote to full we'll pin the cluster to tag v2.3.0-spark?
jess rath: yes — plan: pin tag to stable if no regressions for 15m post-10% ramp. then schedule final rollout to 100% with 5m stepups.
maya nguyen: release note snippet: "inference-runtime v2.3.0: batching kernel improvements, KV-cache compaction bugfix, default quantization variant gptq-4x-quant8."
eng-deploy-bot: Promotion action: pin tag v2.3.0-spark -> pinned as v2.3.0 at 22:08:45 UTC.
eng-deploy-bot: Starting final ramp to 50% -> 100% in 2 steps.
runtime-sre-bot: final checks green. no new anomalies detected in last 10m.
jess rath: approving full promotion. schedule final window close at 22:12 UTC to allow post-rollout monitoring.
eng-deploy-bot: Promotion complete: service inference-runtime at 100% traffic in prod/us-east-1. Tag v2.3.0 pinned across control plane. :shipit:
oliver k: nice work team. will open a short post-deploy note in #postmortems if we need follow-ups.
frank li: thanks all — keep an eye on cost counters (batching change may shift token throughput).
maya nguyen: monitoring continuing for 30m, will report if anything pops.
eng-deploy-bot: Closing thread — canary->promotion finished, rollout metadata saved to https://deploys.redwood/2723456789.
